attchmntText: INCREDIBLE INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Newspaper publication of Unaudited Financial Result for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Incredible Industries Limited filed the newspaper publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The filing was submitted to the BSE, NSE, and CSE on 14th November 2026. Total income from operations was reported at 18,100.62 for the quarter and 39,404.11 for the half year. Net profit after tax stood at 1,724.5 for the quarter and 5,201.8 for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.87 for the quarter and 1.25 for the half year. The results were placed on the company website and stock exchange portals. The document includes financial extracts signed by Chairman and Managing Director Rama Shankar Gupta.

attchmntText: INCREDIBLE INDUSTRIES LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Incredible Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November, 2026. The Board approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 18,100.62 lacs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 172.15 lacs. For the half year, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 39,404.11 lacs, and profit after tax was Rs. 568.40 lacs. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 0.38, and Rs. 1.25 for the half year. The Statutory Auditor issued a Limited Review Report stating that the financial results do not disclose any material misstatements. The meeting commenced at 02:30 P.M. and concluded at 03:55 P.M.

attchmntText: INCREDIBLE INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
